title: Virus Isolation and Sequencing
author: Min Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jh2cj8e

steps.title: Inoculate and Culture Cells
steps.instruction: Inoculate cultured rhabdomyosarcoma (RD) cells and human epidermoid cancer cells (Hep-2) with virally contaminated samples.

steps.title: Harvest Virus
steps.instruction: Observe the cells for three passages and harvest the virus based on the cytopathic effect (CPE).

substeps.instruction: Harvest the virus when the CPE affects 75–100% of the cell monolayer.
If no CPE is observed in the initial cell culture, pass the virus through three generations.

steps.title: Amplify VP1 Gene Sequences
steps.instruction: Analyze the collected viral particles using RT-PCR to amplify the complete VP1 gene sequences from the EV71 and CA16 isolates.

steps.title: Perform DNA Sequencing
steps.instruction: Send the amplified products to Sangon Biotech Co., Ltd (Shanghai, China) for DNA Sanger sequencing.
